_scenario: Property with minimal information — tests confidence degradation
_purpose: Tests that scoring and rent analysis degrade gracefully when evidence is sparse or missing. Confidence must never exceed 'preliminary' with this little data. Rent analysis must return 'insufficient_data'.

evidence._note: Almost no evidence collected — only a data quality score reflecting the gap

expected.notes: With no evidence scores, no comparables, no sqft, and all physical attributes unknown, both scoring and rent analysis must degrade to their lowest-confidence outputs. This fixture guards against the system inventing data to fill gaps.
